item.title: San Ysidro Schools Gave Raises Despite Stern Budget Warning
item.description: County education officials warned leaders of the San Ysidro School District their latest round of employee raises risked putting the district “in jeopardy of not meeting its financial obligations.” The district approved the raises anyway. Leaders now are scrambling to avert insolvency. The post San Ysidro Schools Gave Raises Despite Stern Budget Warning appeared first on Voice of San Diego.
